changelog: - **A model with very large numbers no longer loses resources between a Gate and a Converter.** Where a Gate feeds a Converter, the engine plans the two together so that the Gate takes no more than the Converter can use. With amounts of about a thousand million (10⁹) and more on the connection, that limit was skipped: a Gate that could take 12 thousand million for a Converter using 6 thousand million a run took all 12, and the 6 the Converter did not use disappeared, with no notice. The same model with smaller numbers was always right; only the size of the numbers decided it. The limit now holds at every size, and so do two related cases: a group in which a Gate has two supplies stood still at such amounts, and a Converter with a run rule could run past the fraction its rule allows. Models whose amounts stay below about a hundred million are not affected, and none of the bundled examples changes. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 14).
